map.name: Pellamar
map.setting: a crossroads inn and its hamlet
map.trouble: Hurgg, an Ogre chief, has taken Thornspur Fort north of Pellamar with his Ogres and wolves and shut the north road. Dorvan sent the player to Mayor Corvane.

bounty_offer.specifics: Moggin the goatherd wants the Imp in the well behind his barn killed, the Imp having stirred up the rats.

offer.speaker: Moggin
offer.text:
Good! There's a wicked little Imp nesting in the old well behind our barn, and he's driven the rats wild. Now they bite anyone who comes near my goats -- the sweetest milkers in Pellamar!

Kill the Imp for me. My bow is yours when he's dead.

This iron key opens the barn door.

reminder.speaker: Moggin
reminder.text: It's just one little Imp! Go on and finish him off.

completion.speaker: Moggin
completion.text:
The Imp's dead? Wonderful!

Take my bow, as promised, and show it to Hask at the Lucky Boar. He'll fill a quiver for you. Good luck!

journal.text: Kill the Imp nesting in the well behind Moggin's barn.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Orla the healer lost her healing staff to Urchins and giant bats from the caves east of town.

offer.speaker: Orla
offer.text:
Where have you been all this time!? Something terrible has happened!

Thieving Urchins and giant bats from the caves east of town have broken into my house. They made off with my healing staff, and now the sick of Pellamar go without!

Please, kind sir! Will you get my staff back from those vermin? I will see you well paid.

This key opens the gate in front of the caves. The Urchins' den lies somewhere beyond it.

Take this potion as well, it may come in handy.

refusal.speaker: Orla
refusal.text: Then the sick must suffer, I suppose! I'll find someone with more heart.

reminder.speaker: Orla
reminder.text: Come back with my staff and I'll pay you what I promised.

completion.speaker: Orla
completion.text:
My staff! You've brought it back! Bless you!

Mayor Corvane was here asking for you while you were off in those caves. You'll find him waiting at the Town Hall -- across the square.

Here is some gold for your trouble before you go.

after.speaker: Orla
after.text: Mayor Corvane is an honest man. You'd do well to heed him.

journal.text: Drive the Urchins from the caves east of town. Recover Orla's healing staff.

two_givers.specifics: Mayor Corvane posts a bounty on the outlaw Vesk the Fox; Gubbo the pedlar, robbed by Vesk's cutthroats, wants the gang in irons.

offer_a.speaker: Mayor Corvane
offer_a.text:
Greetings, brave Adventurer. You'll be here for the bounty, I take it.

Vesk the Fox and his cutthroats have robbed every cart on the crossroads since spring. Bring him in dead or alive, and the town will pay a fine price.

Watch yourself. Those rats stab a man the moment he turns his back.

offer_b.speaker: Gubbo
offer_b.text:
To tell the truth, nobody's buying much these days. Last week, cutthroats jumped my cart and took every pot I had.

I'll never lay eyes on those pots again, but I'd love nothing better than to see that gang in irons.

Anybody who puts them there gets a prize from me!

outcome_a.speaker: Mayor Corvane
outcome_a.text:
Dead, is he? I'd wanted Vesk to stand trial, but nobody in Pellamar will shed a tear for that scoundrel!

Your bounty -- 100 gold! The crossroads are safer for your work!

outcome_b.speaker: Gubbo
outcome_b.text:
The cutthroats are in irons at last! Good work, lad! Every honest trader on the road can rest easy knowing those thugs won't be grabbing at our carts anymore!

And here's your prize... the finest boots on my cart! Drop by anytime!

journal_a.text: Hunt down Vesk the Fox and collect Mayor Corvane's bounty.

journal_b.text: Bring Vesk's cutthroats to justice for Gubbo the pedlar.

rescue.specifics: Hask, keeper of the Lucky Boar, begs the player to rescue his potboy Nib from the Ogre camp west of the crossroads.

plea.speaker: Hask
plea.text:
Business? What business! The Ogres have scared every traveler off the road. Yesterday they grabbed my potboy Nib right off the woodpile!

I fear the worst for the boy, but I'd give anything to have him back in my kitchen. They dragged him off to their camp west of the crossroads.

Anyone who brings him home gets a fine reward!

reminder.speaker: Hask
reminder.text: Why are you standing around? Those Ogres have my Nib!

found.speaker: Nib
found.text: Is someone there? Please, get me out of this cage before they come back!

following.speaker: Nib
following.text: Quick! Take me home before they wake up!

completion.speaker: Hask
completion.text:
Nib's home! Thank goodness, lad! Not a soul at the Lucky Boar could eat or sleep while those brutes had him!

Here's your reward... 60 gold! And your room is free here any night you like!

journal.text: Bring Hask's potboy Nib home from the Ogre camp.

main_opening.specifics: Tobb points the player to Mayor Corvane in the Town Hall, who sends him north to Thornspur Fort to face Hurgg and his Ogres.

herald.speaker: Tobb
herald.text: Hurgg must have tamed the wolves of the hills! The fort was quiet one night, and by morning Ogres and wolves were crawling all over it. Mayor Corvane wants to see you.

opening.speaker: Mayor Corvane
opening.text:
Dark days have come upon the crossroads. Hurgg, chief of the Ogres, holds Thornspur Fort, and his brutes plunder every caravan on the north road.

You must go up there and face him.

Here are potions and some gold -- buy whatever else you need at Gubbo's cart, then hurry. The road north over the hill leads straight to the fort.

reminder.speaker: Mayor Corvane
reminder.text: There is no more to say, kind sir. Go on up to the fort and deal with Hurgg!

journal.text: Go north from Pellamar to Thornspur Fort and defeat Hurgg.
